View command execution metrics including timing, frequency, success rates, and
timeout statistics.

This command provides insights into:
  - Command execution times (baseline, fastest, slowest, average)
  - Invocation frequency
  - Success and failure rates
  - Timeout occurrences
  - Error rates

  List all command metrics
  zqk.test system metrics
  View metrics for a specific command
  zqk.test system metrics --command "zqk.test system check"
  Output as JSON
  zqk.test system metrics --format json
  Show only commands with failures
  zqk.test system metrics --filter failures

Usage:
  zqk.test system metrics [flags]
  zqk.test system metrics [command]

Available Commands:
  feed             Push metrics digest to agent_feed with notify
  file-lock        Manage file lock metrics (view buffer, flush)
  scheduler-health Manage scheduler health metrics

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --command string          Filter by specific command pattern
      --filter string           Filter by type (failures, timeouts, slow)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --limit int               Limit number of results (0 = all)
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --summary                 Generate detailed analysis summary report
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk.test system metrics [command] --help" for more information about a command.
